method: Fixed offscreen 960x900 DPR1 stages; fresh processes. first application separated from detached prototype + semantic-seed theme switches. Timings include a cheap detached prototype in switch_back; not cold CSS load, full ThemeManager snapshot, GUI input/display or CPU time. Detailed scopes are inclusive and must not be summed. No tests/builds during accepted measurements.

before.method: Sequential fresh offscreen processes; same immutable local CSS/font dependencies. Two return-to-theme cycles per process. Stage timings are not GUI event/display latency; detailed scopes are inclusive and cannot be summed. Images and sampled geometry/cursor hits are retained for before/after comparison. Full counter reference checked separately after timed stages.
